name: upgauge-api-rate-limit
description: THE THRESHOLD (issue #19's third acceptance criterion, and #52's second option): block a source IP once it exceeds 60 requests per 60-second window on /api/, for 60 seconds. A human on /explore triggers a handful of /api/pivot calls a minute; a scraper walking 22,420 route pages does not fit inside 60/min. robots.txt already disallows /api/ to well-behaved crawlers -- this is the backstop for ones that ignore it.

rules.description: Rate limit /api/ to 60 requests per 60s per source IP so a scraper cannot keep the origin awake
